- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 10–20% for next 3–5 days.  
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.67), model underestimates; increase forecast by 10–20% for next 3–5 days.  
- After a sharp price spike (forecast > 3.0), model often overcorrects with a steep drop; cap forecast decline to 1.5x the prior peak.  
- Model consistently underestimates mean-reversion periods; add 0.1–0.3 to forecast if recent 5-day average is below 2.2.  
- For 30-day horizon, model overestimates in high-sentiment periods; apply 15–25% downward adjustment if sentiment > 0.75 over last 5 days.  
- If sentiment history shows alternating highs/lows, model fails to capture volatility; add 0.2–0.5 to forecast if sentiment swings > 0.5 in last 3 days.
